The saturation finding (outer headroom (1-eps)q ~ 1.68e-10 on the PR1699 supplier) redirects further effort on this outer line to the complex supplier endpoint.
stop_rule: Stop at 60 minutes; report unchecked cited theorems rather than re-deriving SHALLOW-TOEPLITZ or the cost rows.
